edges.label: 1–4 miles / $
edges.note: Choose United as active loyalty partner: 4x scheduled airport; 3x eligible premium/on-demand airport; 1x ordinary eligible rides. Only one loyalty earning partner per ride.

edges.label: 3 points / $
edges.note: Link and select Hilton. One active loyalty partner per ride; terms and exclusions apply.

edges.label: 2–3 points / $
edges.note: 2x everyday eligible rides; 3x airport/premium. One active loyalty partner per ride; excludes taxes, fees, tolls and tips.

edges.label: 2 points / $
edges.note: Set Bilt as active loyalty partner. Can coexist with eligible payment-card earning; do not add all Lyft loyalty partners together.

edges.label: Eligible rides / Eats
edges.note: Linked Delta must be the selected Uber earning partner. Qualifying ride/order types only; cannot also earn Marriott on the same transaction. Not a points transfer.

edges.label: Eligible rides / Eats
edges.note: Select Marriott as Uber earning partner; qualifying rides and Eats orders only. Cannot simultaneously earn Delta on the same transaction.

edges.label: Rewards paid as MR
edges.note: Choose Membership Rewards as Rakuten payout method; eligible US MR account, confirmed purchases and quarterly payout rules apply. Not a transfer of existing MR into Rakuten.

edges.label: Rewards paid as Bilt
edges.note: Choose Bilt as payout method, instead of MR/cash. Conversion varies by Bilt status; a single payout cannot simultaneously be Amex MR and Bilt.

edges.label: Linked-card earning
edges.note: Eligible linked-card pharmacy and retail purchases; exclusions apply. Can stack with payment-card rewards.

edges.label: Linked-account miles
edges.note: Current terms tie qualifying earning to recent Delta flight activity; double Stars on Delta travel days. No conversion of Starbucks Stars to miles.

edges.label: Stay / promo bonuses
edges.note: Linked-account benefits and qualifying promotional activities; no direct conversion of Starbucks Stars to Bonvoy.

edges.label: DashPass ride discounts
edges.note: Linked DashPass members get eligible Lyft discounts; not a rewards-currency transfer.

edges.label: Earns UR
edges.note: Sapphire Reserve earns Ultimate Rewards. Card benefits and transfer access follow card-specific terms.

edges.label: Earns MR
edges.note: US eligible Platinum card earns Membership Rewards. Distinct from co-branded Amex cards.

edges.label: 5x + ride credit
edges.note: 5x TOTAL UR on eligible rides plus $10 monthly Lyft credit, through September 30, 2027. This is card earning/credit, not a Lyft currency transfer.

edges.label: DashPass + offers
edges.note: Activation and payment-card requirements; monthly promotions and expiration dates apply. Not transferable points.

edges.label: Uber Cash + One credit
edges.note: US consumer Platinum: up to $200 annual Uber Cash, distributed monthly; up to $120 annual Uber One statement credit. Enrollment/payment terms apply. Not an MR transfer.
